shared_elements: shallow relief carving of curved bands
a circular disc or ring motif
justification: Both depict the human form and include a circular disc motif set within curved relief bands, but that is about as generic as a correspondence can be. A shows a detailed narrative scene of two bearded figures in profile — one standing with a staff, one seated offering a bowl, with patterned garments, chair and fringing — whereas B is a single frontal/rear monolithic body reduced to a few broad schematic curves, a ring and a belt-like band, with no interacting figures, no profile faces and no narrative arrangement.
